sections.title: A Little Note For You
sections.body:
Dear Riya,

On this special day, I just want you to know how much you mean to me. Every moment with you feels like a gift, and watching you grow, smile, and shine inspires me every single day.

May this new year of your life be filled with laughter, adventure, and all the love you so freely give to others — finally coming back to you.

Happy Birthday, beautiful. Here's to many more memories together.
